{"action":"draft","body":"Subject: IMPORTANT — Seattle team staffing update (Draft — Do NOT send)

***DO NOT SEND: Legal review required before distribution***

Dear Seattle team,

I need to inform you of an upcoming staffing reduction that will affect our Seattle organization. Fourteen roles are impacted. The reduction will be effective October 31.

Managers will begin one-on-one meetings starting tomorrow morning to speak with affected employees. HR will provide details about severance and next steps on Monday.

I recognize this is difficult news. Please wait for your manager’s one-on-one for information specific to you, and direct any immediate questions to HR.

Note for Legal: please review this draft before it is distributed. Do not send until legal sign-off.

Thank you,
[Your name]"}
